female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-inventory-list-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific inventory items to be purchased fund faster.
female-inventory-list-faster.body: Pitches from women that provide detailed lists of specific products or materials to be acquired accelerate funding speed.

female-photo-note-faster.body: Female borrowers who include a specific note about the loan photo may fund faster.

female-narrative-structure-faster.body: Female borrowers who use a standardized or nearly identical narrative structure may fund faster.

female-widow-refugee-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention being a widow or refugee may fund faster.

female-spouse-mention-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention their husband or spouse may fund more slowly.

female-family-future-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family may fund faster.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who include explicit gratitude markers toward lenders may fund more slowly.

female-financial-training-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention receiving financial management training may fund more slowly.

female-loan-amount-faster.body: Female borrowers who request smaller loan amounts may fund faster.

female-large-scale-expansion-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention expanding their business to a large scale in the future may fund faster.
female-large-scale-expansion-faster.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-smallholder-location-faster.title: Female borrowers who identify as a smallholder farmer from a specific location may fund faster.
female-smallholder-location-faster.retrospective: Retired to be replaced by broader geographic location puzzle.

female-external-family-location-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention external family locations may fund more slowly.
female-external-family-location-slower.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for family-future observation.

female-specific-location-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific geographic locations or settlements may fund faster.
female-specific-location-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that narrative detail about local geography predicts slower funding.

female-children-mentions-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention children may fund faster.
female-children-mentions-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning children or family care responsibilities predicts slower funding for women.

work-effort-faster-general.title: Borrowers who describe their active work ethic or current employment status tend to fund faster, regardless of gender.
work-effort-faster-general.retrospective: Dropped to maintain claim cap of 8.

female-professional-role-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific professional roles like seamstress or laborer may fund faster.
female-professional-role-faster.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-children-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention children or family care responsibilities may fund more slowly.
female-children-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by new observation that mentions of children correlate with faster funding.

female-older-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention being aged 50 or older may fund faster.
female-older-age-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that biographical details like age predict slower funding.

female-children-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention children may fund faster, contradicting previous observations.
female-children-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that biographical details like number of children predict slower funding.
